steps: the bundle carries the Core, the simulation, the tool, the generator, the scripts and the manifest
the manifest names the digest of 9 files
the bundle installs no service, publishes no port and names no path of the machine it was built on
the files of the instance are absolute, inside the instance and name the loopback of the host
the generator refuses a relative directory, the personal installation and an instance that is already prepared
the procedure provisions, starts and writes nothing outside the directory of the instance
the code of the operator session is minted over the local IPC of the instance
the instance stops without a signal that is forced
the Core binds the loopback of the host: the tunnel of the operator is the only way in
